description:
Engage Customer Directly with Bright and Shiny Spot UV Postcards


Spot UV postcards bring a polished edge to your marketing. By applying a glossy coating to select areas of your design, these postcards draw attention to key elements like logos, text, or images. The combination of matte stock and glossy accents creates a bold contrast that’s impossible to ignore. Perfect for brand launches, limited-time promotions, and standout event invitations.

Bold Contrast for a Premium Finish

Selective Spot UV Gloss Coating
Matte + Gloss Texture Contrast
Premium Cardstock and Sizes
Highlight logos, text, or images Sharp contrast between flat and gloss Thick 16 pt. cardstock for durability
Guide the reader’s focus Tactile dimension and visual pop Available in matte or gloss finish
Adds a layer of visual intrigue Great for branding and CTA emphasis Sizes include 4" x 6", 5" x 7", and 8.5" x 5.5"

Built for Maximum Visual Impact



Printed on Durable 16 pt. Cardstock

A sturdy, high-quality base that enhances the premium feel of your design.

Available in Gloss or Matte Finish

Choose a sleek shine or soft matte background to contrast with your Spot UV elements.

Highlight What Matters Most

Add gloss to key parts of your design like logos, brand names, or promos.

Popular Sizes That Fit Your Campaign

Choose from 4" x 6", 5" x 7", 8.5" x 5.5", or request a custom size.

Optional File Proofing at Checkout

Make sure everything is set before you print with our free file check.



Spot UV Postcard FAQs

Q: How do I prepare my file for spot UV printing?

The area printed in spot UV should be in a separate vector layer. If you are unable to provide a file that has a separate layer for the spot UV area, you can send us a different high-resolution raster file showing the spot UV section in a different color.

Q: How soon can I receive my spot UV postcards?

The arrival of your order will depend on the receiving address’s location. All spot UV postcards take 6 business days to produce. The order will be shipped after this printing period. To find out how soon you can receive the spot UV postcards, select “Estimate Shipping & Delivery” below the online calculator and input your ZIP code. Several arrival dates will appear based on your location.

Q: Do I save more with bulk printing?

Yes, the larger your order quantity, the lower you spend on each postcard. The online calculator will show the total and unit price after you’ve selected the specifications.
